m_ayatulkursi.title: Ayatul Kursi (The Throne Verse)
m_ayatulkursi.arabicText: اَللّٰهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَۚ اَلۡحَیُّ الۡقَیُّوۡمُ ۬ۚ لَا تَاۡخُذُهٗ سِنَۃٌ وَّ لَا نَوۡمٌ ؕ لَهٗ مَا فِی السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ مَا فِی الۡاَرۡضِ ؕ مَنۡ ذَا الَّذِیۡ یَشۡفَعُ عِنۡدَهٗۤ اِلَّا بِاِذۡنِهٖ ؕ یَعۡلَمُ مَا بَیۡنَ اَیۡدِیۡهِمۡ وَ مَا خَلۡفَهُمۡ ۚ وَ لَا یُحِیۡطُوۡنَ بِشَیۡءٍ مِّنۡ عِلۡمِهٖۤ اِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرۡسِیُّهُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الۡاَرۡضَ ۚ وَ لَا یَـُٔوۡدُهٗ حِفۡظُهُمَا ۚ وَ هُوَ الۡعَلِیُّ الۡعَظِیۡمُ
m_ayatulkursi.transliteration: Allāhu lā ilāha illā huw, al-ḥayyu al-qayyūm, lā ta'khudhuhū sinatun wa lā nawm, lahū mā fī as-samāwāti wa mā fī al-arḍ, man dhā alladhī yashfa'u 'indahū illā bi-idhnih, ya'lamu mā bayna aydīhim wa mā khalfahum, wa lā yuḥīṭūna bi-shay'in min 'ilmihī illā bimā shā'a, wasi'a kursiyyuhū as-samāwāti wa al-arḍa, wa lā ya'ūduhū ḥifẓuhumā, wa huwa al-'aliyyu al-'aẓīm
m_ayatulkursi.translation: Allah – there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi (Throne) extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
m_ayatulkursi.benefit: Whoever recites it in the morning and evening will be protected from jinn throughout the day and night. Reciting it before sleep prevents Satan from drawing near. Reciting it after each of the five obligatory prayers, nothing prevents entry to Paradise except death.
m_ayatulkursi.reference: Surah Al-Baqarah: 255 | Al-Hakim, 2064; Bukhari, 2311; Nasa'i, As-Sunanul Kubra.

m_ikhlas.title: Surah Al-Ikhlas (The Sincerity)
m_ikhlas.arabicText: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ۔ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ۔ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ۔ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
m_ikhlas.transliteration: Qul huwa Allāhu aḥad. Allāhu aṣ-ṣamad. Lam yalid wa lam yūlad. Wa lam yakun lahū kufuwan aḥad.
m_ikhlas.translation: Say: He is Allah, One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born. Nor is there to Him any equivalent.
m_ikhlas.benefit: Reciting Al-Ikhlas once is equivalent to reciting one-third of the entire Quran. Reciting it three times morning and evening suffices as protection from all harm.

m_falaq.title: Surah Al-Falaq (The Daybreak)
m_falaq.arabicText: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ۔ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ۔ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ۔ وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ۔ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
m_falaq.transliteration: Qul a'ūdhu bi-rabb al-falaq. Min sharri mā khalaq. Wa min sharri ghāsiqin idhā waqab. Wa min sharri an-naffāthāti fī al-'uqad. Wa min sharri ḥāsidin idhā ḥasad.
m_falaq.translation: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak. From the evil of that which He created. And from the evil of darkness when it settles. And from the evil of the blowers in knots. And from the evil of an envier when he envies.
m_falaq.benefit: Protects the reciter from all forms of created evil, the harm of darkness, the harm of witchcraft, and the harm of envy. Reciting it three times morning and evening suffices as protection from all harm.

m_nas.title: Surah An-Nas (Mankind)
m_nas.arabicText: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ۔ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ۔ إِلَهِ النَّاسِ۔ مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ۔ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ۔ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
m_nas.transliteration: Qul a'ūdhu bi-rabb an-nās. Malik an-nās. Ilāh an-nās. Min sharri al-waswāsi al-khannās. Alladhī yuwaswisu fī ṣudūr an-nās. Min al-jinnati wa an-nās.
m_nas.translation: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind. The Sovereign of mankind. The God of mankind. From the evil of the retreating whisperer. Who whispers in the breasts of mankind. From among jinn and mankind.
m_nas.benefit: Protects the reciter from the whispering of Satan in the heart, whether from jinn or human sources. Reciting it three times morning and evening suffices as protection from all harm.

m_hasbiyallah.title: Hasbiyallah (Allah Is Sufficient for Me)
m_hasbiyallah.arabicText: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
m_hasbiyallah.transliteration: Ḥasbiyallāhu lā ilāha illā huw, 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa huwa rabbu al-'arshi al-'aẓīm
m_hasbiyallah.translation: Allah is sufficient for me; there is no deity except Him. Upon Him I have relied, and He is the Lord of the Great Throne.
m_hasbiyallah.benefit: Whoever says it 7 times in the morning and 7 times in the evening, Allah will suffice him against all worries and anxieties of this world and the Hereafter.
m_hasbiyallah.reference: Surah At-Tawbah: 129 | Abu Dawud, 5081; Ibn As-Sunni, 71.

m_sayyidul_istighfar.title: Sayyidul Istighfar (Master of Forgiveness)
m_sayyidul_istighfar.arabicText: اَللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّىْ لآ إِلهَ إلاَّ أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَنِىْ وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَأَنَا عَلى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوْذُبِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوْءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَىَّ وَأَبُوْءُ بِذَنْبِىْ فَاغْفِرْ لِىْ، فَإِنَّهُ لاَيَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوْبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
m_sayyidul_istighfar.transliteration: Allāhumma anta rabbī lā ilāha illā anta, khalaqtanī wa anā 'abduka, wa anā 'alā 'ahdika wa wa'dika mā istaṭa'tu. A'ūdhu bika min sharri mā ṣana'tu, abū'u laka bi-ni'matika 'alayya, wa abū'u bi-dhanbī. Faghfir lī fa-innahū lā yaghfiru adh-dhunūba illā ant.
m_sayyidul_istighfar.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no deity except You. You created me and I am Your servant. I am upon Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge before You Your blessing upon me, and I acknowledge my sin. So forgive me, for indeed none forgives sins except You.
m_sayyidul_istighfar.benefit: Whoever recites it with firm conviction in the morning or evening, and dies that day or night, he will certainly be among the people of Paradise.

m_bismillah_la_yadurr.title: Bismillah Protection Supplication
m_bismillah_la_yadurr.arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
m_bismillah_la_yadurr.transliteration: Bismillāhi alladhī lā yaḍurru ma'a ismihi shay'un fī al-arḍi wa lā fī as-samā'i wa huwa as-samī'u al-'alīm
m_bismillah_la_yadurr.translation: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing can cause harm on earth or in the heavens, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
m_bismillah_la_yadurr.benefit: Whoever says it three times every morning and evening, nothing will harm him.

m_la_ilaha_illa_allah_10.title: La Ilaha Illallah (Tahlil – The Declaration of Unity)
m_la_ilaha_illa_allah_10.arabicText: لآ إِلهَ إِلاَّ اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيْكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الُحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ
m_la_ilaha_illa_allah_10.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahū lā sharīka lah, lahul mulku wa lahul ḥamdu wa huwa 'alā kulli shay'in qadīr
m_la_ilaha_illa_allah_10.translation: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, with no partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He is over all things All-Powerful.
m_la_ilaha_illa_allah_10.benefit: Saying it 10 times each morning and evening earns 10 good deeds, erases 10 sins, grants 10 ranks, the reward of freeing 4 slaves, and protection from Satan. Saying it 100 times in the morning brings the reward of freeing 10 slaves, 100 good deeds, erasing 100 sins, and protection from Satan until evening.
m_la_ilaha_illa_allah_10.reference: Ibn Hibban, 2023; Abu Dawud, 5077; Bukhari, 6403; Muslim, 2691.

m_allahumma_bika_asbahna.title: Allahumma Bika Asbahna (O Allah, by Your Grace We Enter the Morning)
m_allahumma_bika_asbahna.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ ، وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
m_allahumma_bika_asbahna.transliteration: Allāhumma bika aṣbaḥnā, wa bika amsaynā, wa bika naḥyā, wa bika namūtu, wa ilayka an-nushūr
m_allahumma_bika_asbahna.translation: O Allah, by Your grace we have reached the morning and by Your grace we have reached the evening. By Your will we live and by Your will we die, and to You is the resurrection.
m_allahumma_bika_asbahna.benefit: A comprehensive morning supplication affirming that all of one's existence – morning, evening, life, death, and resurrection – is entirely by Allah's will and grace.

m_asbahna_ala_fitrah.title: Asbahna 'ala Fitratil Islam (We Have Awoken Upon the Fitrah of Islam)
m_asbahna_ala_fitrah.arabicText: أَصْبَحْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ، وَعَلَى دِيْنِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِيْنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
m_asbahna_ala_fitrah.transliteration: Aṣbaḥnā 'alā fiṭrati al-islām, wa 'alā kalimati al-ikhlāṣ, wa 'alā dīni nabiyyinā Muḥammadin ṣallallāhu 'alayhi wa sallam, wa 'alā millati abīnā Ibrāhīma ḥanīfan musliman wa mā kāna min al-mushrikīn
m_asbahna_ala_fitrah.translation: We have reached the morning upon the natural disposition of Islam, upon the word of sincerity (La ilaha illallah), upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), and upon the creed of our father Ibrahim, who was upright and a Muslim, and he was not of the polytheists.
m_asbahna_ala_fitrah.benefit: A declaration renewing one's commitment to Islam, Tawhid, the Prophetic way, and the Abrahamic monotheistic tradition every morning and evening.

m_allahumma_fatir.title: Allahumma 'Alimal Ghayb
m_allahumma_fatir.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطانِ وَشَرَكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى  نَفْسِي سُوءاً، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ
m_allahumma_fatir.transliteration: Allāhumma 'ālima al-ghaybi wash-shahādah, fāṭiras-samāwāti wal-arḍ, rabba kulli shay'in wamalīkah, ash-hadu allā ilāha illā ant. A'ūdhu bika min sharri nafsī, wamin sharrish-shayṭāni washirkihi, wa-an aqtarifa 'alā nafsī sū'an aw ajurrahu ilā muslim.
m_allahumma_fatir.translation: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things, I bear witness that there is no deity except You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil of Satan and his traps, and from committing wrong against myself or bringing it upon any Muslim.
m_allahumma_fatir.benefit: Seeking Allah's protection from internal evil (one's own soul), external evil (Satan), and causing harm to others – covering all dimensions of potential wrongdoing.

m_afwa_wal_afiyah.title: Allahumma As'alukal 'Afwa (O Allah, I Ask You for Pardon)
m_afwa_wal_afiyah.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي، وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
m_afwa_wal_afiyah.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka al-'afwa wa al-'āfiyata fī ad-dunyā wa al-ākhirah. Allāhumma innī as'aluka al-'afwa wa al-'āfiyata fī dīnī wa dunyāya wa ahlī wa mālī. Allāhummastir 'awrātī wa āmin raw'ātī. Allāhumma ḥfaẓnī min bayni yadayya wa min khalfī wa 'an yamīnī wa 'an shimālī wa min fawqī, wa a'ūdhu bi-'aẓamatika an ughtāla min taḥtī
m_afwa_wal_afiyah.translation: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this world and the Hereafter. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religion, my worldly affairs, my family, and my wealth. O Allah, conceal my faults and calm my fears. O Allah, guard me from what is in front of me, from what is behind me, from my right, from my left, and from above me, and I seek refuge in Your Greatness from being struck down from beneath me.
m_afwa_wal_afiyah.benefit: The Prophet (peace be upon him) considered this supplication comprehensive enough to cover all aspects of one's protection. It guards one's religion, worldly life, family, wealth, and physical safety from all six directions.

m_allahumma_afini.title: Allahumma 'Afini fi Badani (O Allah, Grant Me Well-Being in My Body)
m_allahumma_afini.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالْفَقْرِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ.
m_allahumma_afini.transliteration: Allāhumma 'āfinī fī badanī. Allāhumma 'āfinī fī sam'ī. Allāhumma 'āfinī fī baṣarī. Lā ilāha illā anta. Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika min al-kufri wa al-faqr. Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika min 'adhābi al-qabr. Lā ilāha illā anta.
m_allahumma_afini.translation: O Allah, grant me well-being in my body. O Allah, grant me well-being in my hearing. O Allah, grant me well-being in my sight. There is no deity except You. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from disbelief and poverty. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave. There is no deity except You.
m_allahumma_afini.benefit: Seeks Allah's protection for the body's three most vital faculties: physical health, hearing, and sight, along with seeking refuge from disbelief, poverty, and the punishment of the grave.

m_asbahna_wal_mulku.title: Asbahna wa Asbahal Mulku (We Have Reached the Morning and the Kingdom Belongs to Allah)
m_asbahna_wal_mulku.arabicText: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
m_asbahna_wal_mulku.transliteration: Aṣbaḥnā wa aṣbaḥa al-mulku lillāh, wa al-ḥamdu lillāh, lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahū lā sharīka lah, lahul mulku wa lahul ḥamdu wa huwa 'alā kulli shay'in qadīr. Rabb as'aluka khayra mā fī hādha al-yawmi wa khayra mā ba'dah, wa a'ūdhu bika min sharri mā fī hādha al-yawmi wa sharri mā ba'dah. Rabb a'ūdhu bika min al-kasali wa sū'i al-kibar. Rabb a'ūdhu bika min 'adhābin fī an-nāri wa 'adhābin fī al-qabr.
m_asbahna_wal_mulku.translation: We have reached the morning and the whole dominion belongs to Allah. All praise is for Allah. There is no deity except Allah, alone, with no partner. To Him belongs the dominion and all praise, and He is over all things All-Powerful. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and the good that follows it. And I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil that follows it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and the misery of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from punishment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.
m_asbahna_wal_mulku.benefit: A comprehensive morning supplication combining praise of Allah, declaration of His unique sovereignty, and seeking protection from five specific evils: the day's harm, the future's harm, laziness, painful old age, and punishment in Fire and grave.

m_subhanallah_bihamdihi_100.title: Subhanallahi wa Bihamdihi (Glory and Praise be to Allah)
m_subhanallah_bihamdihi_100.translation: Glory be to Allah and all praise is for Him.
m_subhanallah_bihamdihi_100.benefit: Whoever recites this 100 times in the morning and evening, no one on the Day of Resurrection will come with something better than what he brought, unless someone else said the same or more. Even sins as numerous as the foam of the sea will be forgiven.

m_allahumma_ashhaduka.title: Allahumma Inni Asbahtu (O Allah, I Have Reached the Morning Bearing Witness)
m_allahumma_ashhaduka.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ وَأَشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ وَمَلَائِكَتَكَ وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ، بِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
m_allahumma_ashhaduka.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aṣbaḥtu ushhiduka wa ashhidu ḥamalata 'arshika wa malā'ikataka wa jamī'a khalqika, bi-annaka anta Allāhu lā ilāha illā anta waḥdaka lā sharīka laka wa anna Muḥammadan 'abduka wa rasūluk
m_allahumma_ashhaduka.translation: O Allah, I have reached the morning and I call You to witness, and I call to witness the bearers of Your Throne, Your angels, and all of Your creation, that indeed You are Allah, there is no deity except You alone with no partner, and that Muhammad is Your servant and Messenger.
m_allahumma_ashhaduka.benefit: Whoever says it four times in the morning, Allah will free him from the Fire that day. And whoever says it four times in the evening, Allah will free him from the Fire that night.

m_ya_hayyu_ya_qayyum.title: Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyum (O Ever-Living, O Sustainer)
m_ya_hayyu_ya_qayyum.arabicText: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّوْمُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ اَسْتَغِيْثُ ، أَصْلِحُ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
m_ya_hayyu_ya_qayyum.transliteration: Yā ḥayyu yā qayyūmu bi-raḥmatika astaghīth, aṣliḥ lī sha'nī kullahu, wa lā takilnī ilā nafsī ṭarfata 'ayn
m_ya_hayyu_ya_qayyum.translation: O Ever-Living, O Eternal Sustainer of all, by Your mercy I seek relief. Rectify for me all of my affairs, and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.
m_ya_hayyu_ya_qayyum.benefit: A powerful supplication using two of Allah's most comprehensive names – Al-Hayy (The Ever-Living) and Al-Qayyum (The Sustainer) – to seek help in rectifying one's entire life and affairs.

m_allahumma_ma_asbaha.title: Allahumma Ma Asbaha Bi (O Allah, Whatever Blessing I Have Received This Morning)
m_allahumma_ma_asbaha.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصْبَحَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِّنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
m_allahumma_ma_asbaha.transliteration: Allāhumma mā aṣbaḥa bī min ni'matin aw bi-aḥadin min khalqika fa-minka waḥdaka lā sharīka lak, fa-lakal ḥamdu wa laka ash-shukr
m_allahumma_ma_asbaha.translation: O Allah, whatever blessing I have received this morning or any of Your creation has received, it is from You alone with no partner. So to You belongs all praise and all thanks.
m_allahumma_ma_asbaha.benefit: This supplication is a daily acknowledgment that all blessings – whether personal or enjoyed by any of Allah's creation – come exclusively from Allah. It is considered a fulfillment of the daily duty of thanking Allah.

m_subhanallah_bihamdihi_3.title: Subhanallahi wa Bihamdihi Adada Khalqihi (Glory to Allah Equal to the Number of His Creation)
m_subhanallah_bihamdihi_3.arabicText: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
m_subhanallah_bihamdihi_3.transliteration: Subḥānallāhi wa biḥamdih, 'adada khalqih, wa riḍā nafsih, wa zinata 'arshih, wa midāda kalimātih
m_subhanallah_bihamdihi_3.translation: Glory be to Allah and all praise is for Him, equal to the number of His creation, to His own satisfaction, to the weight of His Throne, and to the ink of His words.
m_subhanallah_bihamdihi_3.benefit: The Prophet (peace be upon him) informed that this phrase surpasses other forms of dhikr because it is said only three times but carries unlimited reward equivalent to the number of Allah's creation, His satisfaction, the weight of His Throne, and the ink of His words.

m_radhitu_billah.title: Radhitu Billahi Rabba (I Am Pleased with Allah as My Lord)
m_radhitu_billah.arabicText: رَضِيْتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبَّا، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيًّا
m_radhitu_billah.transliteration: Raḍītu billāhi rabban, wa bil-islāmi dīnan, wa bi-Muḥammadin nabiyyan
m_radhitu_billah.translation: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad as my Prophet.
m_radhitu_billah.benefit: Whoever says it three times in the morning and evening, it is incumbent upon Allah to please him on the Day of Resurrection.

m_allahumma_ilman_nafian.title: Allahumma Inni As'aluka 'Ilman Nafi'a (O Allah, I Ask You for Beneficial Knowledge)
m_allahumma_ilman_nafian.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا ، وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا، وَعَمَلًا مُّتَقَبَّلاً
m_allahumma_ilman_nafian.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka 'ilman nāfi'an, wa rizqan ṭayyiban, wa 'amalan mutaqabbalan
m_allahumma_ilman_nafian.translation: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, pure and wholesome provision, and accepted deeds.
m_allahumma_ilman_nafian.benefit: Combines three of the most essential needs for a believer's success: beneficial knowledge (foundation of righteous action), pure provision (sustenance of body and soul), and accepted deeds (the goal of every act of worship).

m_allahumma_ajirni_min_nar.title: Allahumma Ajirni Minannar (O Allah, Save Me from the Fire)
m_allahumma_ajirni_min_nar.translation: O Allah, protect me from the Fire.
m_allahumma_ajirni_min_nar.benefit: Whoever says it 7 times after Fajr or Maghrib before speaking to anyone, if he dies that day or night, Allah will protect him from the Fire.

m_subhanallah.title: Subhanallah (Glory be to Allah)
m_subhanallah.benefit: Better than going forth in the path of Allah on 100 camels (i.e., donating 100 camels in charity for Allah's cause).
m_subhanallah.reference: At-Targhib wat-Tarhib, 974; Sahihu't-Targhib, 658; Nasa'i; Sunanul Kubra, 10588.

m_alhamdulillah.title: Alhamdulillah (All Praise is for Allah)
m_alhamdulillah.benefit: Better than going forth with 100 horses fully equipped and mounted for the cause of Allah in battle.
m_alhamdulillah.reference: At-Targhib wat-Tarhib, 974; Sahihu't-Targhib, 658; Nasa'i; Sunanul Kubra, 10588.

m_allahu_akbar.title: Allahu Akbar (Allah is the Greatest)
m_allahu_akbar.reference: At-Targhib wat-Tarhib, 974; Sahihu't-Targhib, 658; Nasa'i; Sunanul Kubra, 10588.

m_morning_blessings.title: Morning Supplication for the Day's Blessings
m_morning_blessings.arabicText: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ فَتْحَهُ، وَنَصْرَهُ، وَنُورَهُ، وَبَرَكَتَهُ، وَهُدَاهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيهِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ
m_morning_blessings.transliteration: Aṣbaḥnā wa aṣbaḥa al-mulku lillāhi rabb al-'ālamīn. Allāhumma innī as'aluka khayra hādha al-yawmi fatḥahu, wa naṣrahu, wa nūrahu, wa barakatahu, wa hudāh. Wa a'ūdhu bika min sharri mā fīhi wa sharri mā ba'dah.
m_morning_blessings.translation: We have reached the morning and the whole dominion belongs to Allah, Lord of all the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this day: its opening (victory), its aid, its light, its blessing, and its guidance. And I seek refuge in You from the evil that is in it and the evil that follows it.
m_morning_blessings.benefit: At the very start of the day, one seeks from Allah five most precious blessings: victory/openings, help, light, baraka (blessings), and guidance for the day, while seeking refuge from all harm of the day and beyond.

m_astaghfirullah.title: Daily Istighfar (Seeking Allah's Forgiveness)
m_astaghfirullah.translation: I seek Allah's forgiveness and I repent to Him.
m_astaghfirullah.benefit: Through this, sins are forgiven and closeness to Allah is attained. The Prophet (peace be upon him) himself used to seek forgiveness more than 70 times a day, demonstrating its importance for every believer.

m_salawat_alan_nabi.title: Salawat upon the Prophet (ﷺ)
m_salawat_alan_nabi.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
m_salawat_alan_nabi.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim 'alā nabiyyinā Muḥammad
m_salawat_alan_nabi.translation: O Allah, bestow Your prayers (blessings) and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad.
m_salawat_alan_nabi.benefit: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Whoever sends blessings upon me ten times in the morning and ten times in the evening will be fortunate to receive my intercession on the Day of Resurrection.
m_salawat_alan_nabi.reference: Imam At-Tabarani (chain of transmission is good/hasan).
